{{External|rs}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Billy, a guard of Falador |image = [[File:Billy, a guard of Falador.png|150px]] |release = [[30 August]] [[2005]] |update = Garden Of Tranquillity |members = Yes |race = [[Human]] |quest = [[Garden of Tranquillity]] |location = North [[Falador]] (cutscene) |gender = Male |options = None |examine = Somebody should have warned him when he signed up. |map = No |id = 1395 |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} [[File:Billy, a guard of Falador chathead.png|left]] '''Billy, a guard of Falador''' is a [[Falador]] [[guard]]sman seen during the [[Garden of Tranquillity]] quest. Billy is shown to be working with another guard, named [[Bob, another guard of Falador|Bob]], to protect Falador's northern entrance. Both are assumed to be killed offscreen by [[PKMaster0036]], a [[player spoof]]. Billy's death allows the player to sneak a statue of [[Saradomin]] out of central Falador unnoticed, eventually allowing them to reach [[Varrock Palace]]. They are also referenced briefly during the [[Ratcatchers]] [[quest]], in which guards in the [[East Ardougne]] mansion occasionally say "I miss Billy and Bob," even if the player hasn't yet started Garden of Tranquillity. ==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|speaksin}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = The NPC's chainbody was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Billy, a guard of Falador (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Billy, a guard of Falador.png|center|300x150px]] |- |30 August 2005 –

revision.text:
{{External|rs|rsc=Booking of Binding}} {{Infobox Item |name = Binding book |image = [[File:Binding book.png]] |release = [[20 August]] [[2003]] |update = New - Legends Quest! |aka = Book of Binding |members = Yes |quest = [[Legends' Quest]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Read, Enchant-Vials, Drop |examine = An ancient tome on Demonology. |value = 1 |weight = 0.510 |id = 730 }} [[File:Binding book detail.png|left|160px]] The '''binding book''' is an integral part of the [[Legends' Quest]]. It contains information on demons and can also create [[enchanted vial]]s, which are required to make [[holy water]]. To get the book, go into the [[mossy rock]] and make sure you have the "SMELL" runes: 1 [[soul rune]], 1 [[mind rune]], 1 [[earth rune]], and 2 [[law rune]]s. In addition, bring a cut [[sapphire]], [[emerald]], [[ruby]], [[diamond]], [[red topaz]], [[jade]], and [[opal]] to place onto certain spots in the cave. For more details, please see [[Legends' Quest#Binding book|this section]] on the quest guide. To enchant vials, use the 'Enchant-Vials' option by right-clicking on the book. This process temporarily drains [[Magic]] and [[Prayer]], both of which players need to keep at level 10 or higher for the enchantment to work. Players can then pour [[Golden bowl#Pure water|pure water from a golden bowl]] into the enchanted vials to make holy water, which will weaken demons (namely [[Nezikchened]]) in combat. Also during [[Legends' Quest]], players can use the book on [[Ungadulu]] when he is possessed to release him from Nezikchened's control. After doing the quest, this book can be found in the [[bookcase]] in your [[Player-owned house|house]]. It can also be re-obtained by bringing the required gems and solving the puzzle, again. If lost BEFORE completing the quest, players must re-obtain it by bringing another batch of gems to the cave and repeating the process. The "SMELL" runes are not required once the door has been unlocked. ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|Binding book|transclude=yes}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 12 February 2007 |update = A sq'irk a day... |change = The item was renamed from "Book of binding" to "Binding book". }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 26 April –
6 June 2005 |change = The "Enchant-vials" option was added. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Binding book detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Binding book detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Binding book (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Binding book.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
Beta |29 March 2004 –
present |} ==Gallery== Binding book (interface, 1).png|Pages 1-2 Binding book (interface, 2).png|Pages 3-4 Binding book (interface, 3).png|Pages 5-6 Binding book (interface, 4).png|Pages 7-8 Binding book (interface, 5).png|Pages 9-10 ==Trivia== *The incantations in the book are written in {{wp|dog Latin}}. *Trying to place gems on a [[carved rock]] while holding the binding book will not allow the player to place them and will yield the messages, "''You carefully move the gem closer to the rock.''", "''Nothing seems to happen...''", "''The 'Book of Binding' seems to vibrate in your inventory.''" {{Legends' Quest}} [[Category:Texts and tomes]] [[Category:Storable in Bookcase]]

revision.text:
{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Biohazard |number = 38 |image = [[File:Biohazard.png|300px]] |release = [[23 October]] [[2002]] |update = Updates galore! |members = Yes |series = [[Quests/Series#Elf|Elf]], #2 |developer = [[Mod Tom|Tom W]] }} '''Biohazard''' continues the storyline after the [[Plague City]] quest. The plot deepens as [[Elena]] finally gets a chance to process her [[plague sample]]s. Buried under these samples lies a well-hidden secret.
==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[Elena]] in her house in [[East Ardougne]]. |startmap = 2592,3336 |difficulty = Novice |description = This is the second part of an ongoing adventure. Help Elena discover the truth about the infamous Ardougne plague.
Smuggle test samples across Ardougne to Elena's old mentor. |length = Short |requirements = *Completion of [[Plague City]] |items = * [[Priest gown top]] and [[Priest gown bottom|bottom]] (can be obtained for free during the quest) * [[Gas mask]] (can be obtained for free from the cupboard in [[Edmond]] and [[Alrena]]'s house in [[East Ardougne]]) |recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|10|link=yes}} *[[Weight-reducing clothing]] and [[Stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s *Fast travel to several locations **[[East Ardougne]] to start the quest plus 1-2 trips - [[Ardougne Teleport]] or [[Skills necklace]] to [[Fishing Guild]] or [[Spirit tree]] to [[Battlefield]] or [[fairy ring]] to {{fairycode|djp}} or [[Captain Barnaby]]'s ship from [[Rimmington]] or [[Brimhaven]] **[[Rimmington]] (1 trip) - [[Teleport to House]] (the default house location is Rimmington) or [[Skills necklace]] to the Crafting Guild or [[Rat Pits]] [[minigame]] teleport **[[Varrock]] (1 trip) - [[Varrock teleport]] or [[Chronicle]] or [[Skills necklace]] to [[Crafting Guild]] or [[Ring of wealth]] to [[Grand Exchange]] |kills = * [[Mourner (boss)|Mourner]] ''(level 13)'' |leagueRegion = <poem> Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Tirannwn}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest </poem> }}
==Walkthrough== ===Sneaking back=== {{Needed|[[gas mask]], two free inventory spaces}} [[File:Elena chathead.png|left|frameless]] {{Map|2614,3325|mtype=rectangle|rectX=8|rectY=6|caption=Jerico's house with pigeon cages and bird food.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} {{Map|mtype=polygon|2559,3267|2561,3267|2561,3262|2557,3262|2557,3264|2559,3264|caption=Omart's location.|align=left|width=200|height=200}} Talk to [[Elena]] in [[East Ardougne]], directly west of the shortcut log. The mourners have confiscated her [[distillator]], which she needs to test plague samples. She wants you to retrieve it, but the tunnel the player used to enter West Ardougne last time has been filled in. She suggests you talk to her father's friend [[Jerico]], who has a method of communication with [[West Ardougne]].
[[Jerico]] can be found in a house just south of the northern bank, and just north of the [[chapel]]. Talk to him, and he will tell you that he has used messenger pigeons to communicate with two friends who are going to help you with a rope ladder to cross the wall.
Open and search the [[cupboard (Jerico's house)|cupboard]] on the north wall to find some [[bird feed]], then go behind the house to grab a [[pigeon cage]].
Ensure you have your gas mask, then speak to [[Omart]], who can be found by the wall just north of the [[Battlefield]] [[Spirit tree]], near [[Ceril Carnillean]]'s house. He will ask you to create a distraction to occupy the watchtower guards before his assistant [[Kilron]] can help you over the wall.
[[File:Biohazard - Releasing the pigeons.png|thumb|200px|Creating a distraction.]] Head to the small watchtower along the wall, directly north of [[Omart]]. Stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet, put the [[bird feed]] on either fence, then click the cage in your inventory to create the distraction.
Go back and talk to [[Omart]], who will call out to [[Kilron]] to throw over the rope ladder. With the [[gas mask]] equipped, climb over the ladder into [[West Ardougne]]. {{Clear|left}}
===Infiltrating the Mourner HQ=== {{Needed|Combat equipment to kill the level 13 Mourner, four free inventory spaces}} [[File:Biohazard - Mourner Tunnels.png|thumb|left|200px|Mourner HQ.]] {{Map|2517,3274|mtype=rectangle|rectX=4|rectY=8|caption=Nurse Sarah's house.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} Head to the [[Mourner Headquarters|Mourners' headquarters]] located in the north-eastern corner of the city. If you tried to enter you would not be allowed in; instead, head to the western side and squeeze through a [[fence (Biohazard)|gap in the fence]] into the backyard. Pick up the [[rotten apple]] laying on the ground just to the west of the fence hole, and right click to use it on the stew that is brewing in the cauldron for the mourners. If you tried to enter the headquarters again, they would complain that several mourners have been taken ill with food poisoning, and are in need of a nurse.
Head to [[nurse Sarah]]'s house - the large building south-west of the [[West Ardougne]] church. Search the [[cupboard (Nurse Sarah's house)|cupboard]] in the northern part of her house to obtain a [[medical gown]]. Equip the gown, and go back to the headquarters. The professional attire will easily fool the mourners into letting you into their base. For all subsequent visits to the headquarters during the quest, the gown must be worn at all times.
Go upstairs and kill a mourner. A [[Key (Biohazard)|key]] will automatically be placed in the player's inventory. Use the key on the [[gate (Biohazard)|gate]] to get inside the caged room. Search the [[crate (Biohazard)|crate]] third from the left on the northern wall to find [[Elena]]'s [[distillator]].
'''Note''': [[Rings of recoil]] work against the mourner, after talking to him he will attack you and the key will still drop.
Go back to [[Elena]] by climbing down the [[manhole (West Ardougne)|manhole]] in the middle of the city and climbing the mud pile. Alternatively, [[Kilron]] at the south-eastern corner of [[West Ardougne]] will help the player get back over into [[East Ardougne]].
Speak to [[Elena]] and the player will give her the distillator. After running the tests, she will be confused to find that the touch paper hasn't changed colour at all. She will give you a [[plague sample]], [[liquid honey]], [[ethenea]], and [[sulphuric broline]], and ask you to visit her old mentor [[Guidor]] in [[Varrock]] for guidance. First, you will need to visit the [[Chemist]] in [[Rimmington]] to obtain more [[touch paper]] and to find a way to smuggle the three vials into [[Varrock]].
===Smuggling goods=== {{Needed| [[Liquid honey]], [[ethenea]], [[sulphuric broline]], the [[plague sample]], and one free inventory space}} {{Map|2933,3210|mtype=rectangle|rectX=16|rectY=8|caption=The chemist's location.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} [[File:Chemist chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]] Make your way to the [[Chemist]] in western [[Rimmington]], who will give you the [[touch paper]]; you need to have the [[plague sample]] in your inventory to talk to him about the quest.
'''Note''': You may fast travel to [[Rimmington]]; the vials used to break when doing so, but this is no longer the case. For a list of transportation options to Rimmington [[Rimmington#Transportation|see here]].
The chemist will advise you to use his errand boys to deliver the goods, but warns you that they have a habit of stealing, and that you must give them each something they have no reason to steal.
{|class="wikitable" |- !Helper !Sample Vial !Reason |- |[[Da Vinci]] |[[File:Ethenea.png]][[Ethenea]] |Da Vinci cannot use the ethenea to create a "work of art". |- |[[Chancy]] |[[File:Liquid honey.png]][[Liquid honey]] |Owing to its low value, Chancy cannot wager the liquid honey in a gamble. |- |[[Hops (Biohazard)|Hops]] |[[File:Sulphuric broline.png]][[Sulphuric broline]] |Hops will not drink it because of its poisonous nature. |}
Chancy the gambler, Da Vinci the artist, and Hops the drinker are located right outside the chemist's house crowding around a fire. Talk to each of them to give them their respective vials. If you give the wrong vial to someone, give the remaining vials to the others, speak to them all in Varrock, then return to Elena to get new vials before repeating this step.
===So far, so good=== {{Needed|A [[priest gown]] top and bottom, the [[plague sample]] and [[touch paper]], and three free inventory spaces}} {{Map|3271,3392|mtype=rectangle|rectX=10|rectY=8|caption=The Dancing Donkey Inn's location.|align=right|width=220|height=220}} [[File:Guidor.png|left|frameless|80px]] Head to the fenced-in enclosure in south-eastern Varrock. The guard will search you when you try and pass through the gate, but will not find the plague sample; he will however confiscate the vials if you forgot to give them to the errand boys, and you will need to repeat the step.
The errand boys can be found in the [[Dancing Donkey Inn]] inside this area. With the plague sample in your inventory and '''three free inventory slots''', talk to Hops, Da Vinci, and Chancy to get the vials back. If your inventory is full when you talk to them, you will need to obtain a new set from the chemist.
{{Colour|red|Warning:}} Now that you have the vials, '''do not leave the fenced area''', or they will be confiscated on return. If you forgot your plague sample or touch paper, you can drop the vials at the gate, quickly retrieve your items from the [[Varrock east bank]] and then pick up the vials again.
Guidor is ill, and his wife [[Julie]] will not let anyone visit him, though she wishes for him to see a priest. If you didn't bring a [[priest gown]], you can obtain one for free by talking to [[Asyff]] in the [[Fancy Clothes Store]] in this area. Equip your [[priest gown]] and then talk to [[Guidor]] in his house in the south-eastern corner of the gated area. Give him the vials and sample, and tell him that [[Elena]] has sent a sample that needs to be processed. After analysing it, he will come to the conclusion that there is no plague - someone has been lying about it.
===Exposing the lie=== [[File:King Lathas chathead.png|left|frameless]] Return to [[Ardougne]], and talk to Elena. When you tell her that [[Guidor]] found nothing in his results, she suggests that the plague must be a hoax and that you should speak to the person on top of this - [[King Lathas]] of [[East Ardougne]]. King Lathas is located just south of Elena's house, in his throne-room on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the East [[Ardougne Castle]].
When told that the plague is in fact a hoax, the King replies that he did it for the best of his people, and that it protects them from a "far greater danger". He then tells the player about the journey of [[King Tyras]] - the king of [[West Ardougne]] and King Lathas's brother - towards the west and that he has been corrupted by the [[Dark Lord]] after drinking from the Chalice of Eternity. Hence, the wall has been erected between the cities to protect [[East Ardougne]] and in turn, all of [[Gielinor]].
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = Biohazard |image = [[File:Biohazard reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 3 |rewards = *{{SCP|Thieving|1,250}} [[Thieving]] [[experience]] *Use of the [[Combat Training Camp]] north of the city. Players can attack a total of six training dummies in the camp for 50 attack experience each. *The ability to travel freely through the [[West Ardougne]] gate. *The ability to use the [[West Ardougne Teleport]] in the [[Arceuus spellbook]] and teletab. }}
==Required for completing== Completion of Biohazard is required for the following: *[[Recipe for Disaster]]: [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide|Freeing the Lumbridge Guide]] *[[Underground Pass]] *[[Ardougne Diary#Easy|Ardougne Diary (Easy)]]
==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|Quest}}
==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 July 2019 |update = Song of the Elves |change = * Teleporting with the plague sample and vials no longer breaks them. * The errand boy hands over the vials faster. * Talking to the Chemist or Guidor does not affect quest items. }} {{Subject changes footer}}
==Trivia== *[[Da Vinci]] is a reference to the famous multi-talented Italian, {{wp|Leonardo da Vinci}}. *The name of the man who helps you get over the wall, [[Jerico]], could be a reference to {{wp|Battle of Jericho|Jericho's wall}}.
{{Biohazard}}

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Bird book |image = [[File:Bird book.png]] |release = [[28 November]] [[2006]] |update = Eagles' Peak |aka = William Oddity's Guide to the Avian |members = Yes |quest = [[Eagles' Peak]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Read, Drop |examine = The title reads 'William Oddity's Guide to the Avian.' |value = 1 |weight = 0.010 |id = 10173 }} [[File:Bird book detail.png|left|130px]] The '''Bird book''' (properly titled '''''William Oddity's Guide to the Avian''''') is a book that players find as part of the [[Eagles' Peak]] quest. It is written by [[William Oddity]], an expert on hunting.
It provides a short commentary on several birds that players can hunt via the [[Hunter]] skill, namely the [[crimson swift]], the [[cerulean twitch]], the [[golden warbler]], the [[tropical wagtail]], and the [[copper longtail]].
However, it also gives vague information about the elusive [[giant eagle]], and hints at the existence of the [[eagle transport system]] and the location of the secret hidden entrance to the [[Eagles' Peak Dungeon]].
After completing the quest, players can only find this book in the [[bookcase]] of their [[player-owned house]]; the stack of books it was originally found in during the quest can no longer be searched.

Happy Birthday to OSRS Mobile!
''After event:'' It's gone off - you'd better throw it away. |value = 1 |weight = 0.100 |id = 24331 }} [[File:Birthday cake (Mobile Anniversary) detail.png|left|100px]] The '''birthday cake''' is an item obtained from the large cakes in [[Varrock Square]] in commemoration of the [[Mobile Anniversary|first anniversary]] of [[Old School RuneScape Mobile]]. Eating the cake heals six [[hitpoints]]. There is no limit to the number of slices players can take from the fountain, aside from inventory size. While they are tradeable, they cannot be sold on the [[Grand Exchange]]. Taking a slice from the fountain for the first time after logging in causes the chatbox to display a message: ''"You can take this slice of cake just about anywhere with you, just like OSRS Mobile!"'' Players using the desktop client can right-click the cake and click the "Learn-more" option, which prompts a confirmation message to open [https://www.oldschool.runescape.com/mobile this link] in the player's browser. If players select the "Learn-more" option on the mobile version, the chatbox will state ''"You are currently playing on mobile. You seem to know what you are doing!"'' [[File:Mobile Anniversary.png|thumb|left|300px|Varrock Square's fountain transformed into four giant slices of cake.]] ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 7 November 2019 |update = Bounty Hunter Rework |change = *The "Eat" and "Learn-more" options were removed. *The item could no longer be made into banknotes. }} {{Subject changes footer}} [[Category:Food]] [[Category:Mobile Anniversary]]

{{External|rs|rsc=Black 2-handed Sword}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black 2h sword |image = [[File:Black 2h sword.png]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A two handed sword. |value = 1920 |weight = 3.628 |exchange = Yes |id = 1313 }} [[File:Black_2h_sword_detail.png|left|80px]] The '''black 2h sword''' is a [[two-handed sword]] stronger than the [[steel 2h sword]], requiring level 10 [[Attack]] to wield. Players can purchase this two-handed sword from [[Gaius' Two Handed Shop]] in [[Taverley]]. It can also be a reward from the [[Observatory Quest]], from the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton minigame]], completing a [[Treasure Trails|Treasure Trail]] or as a drop from various monsters. As with all [[Black equipment|black]] and [[white equipment]], the black 2h sword cannot be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = -4 |aslash = +27 |acrush = +21 |amagic = -4 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = -1 |str = +26 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 7 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = 2h Sword |image = [[File:Black 2h sword equipped male.png|140px]] |altimage = [[File:Black 2h sword equipped female.png|140px]] }} {{CombatStyles|2h Sword|speed=7|attackrange=1}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black 2h sword}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black 2h sword}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 23 August 2005 |update = Blast Furnace |change = The item's equip animation was changed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 31 May 2005 |update = New Emotes And Other Tweaks |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black 2h sword detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black 2h sword (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black 2h sword (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Black 2h sword.png|center]] |[[File:Black 2h sword.png|center]] |- | |[[File:Black 2h sword equipped male (historical v1).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword equipped male (historical v2).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |RuneScape 2

{{Infobox NPC |version1 = 1 |version2 = 2 |version3 = 3 |name = Black Guard |image1 = [[File:Black Guard (Making Friends with My Arm, 1).png|x300px]] |image2 = [[File:Black Guard (Making Friends with My Arm, 2).png|x300px]] |image3 = [[File:Black Guard (Making Friends with My Arm, 3).png|x300px]] |release = [[6 September]] [[2018]] |update = Making Friends With My Arm, Deadman Autumn Finals and Full Mobile Launch |members = Yes |race = [[Dwarf]] |quest = [[Making Friends with My Arm]] |location = [[Keldagrim]] |gender = Male |options = None |examine = Defenders of Keldagrim. |map = No |id1 = 8474 |id2 = 8475 |id3 = 8476 |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Black Guard (Making Friends with My Arm, 1) chathead.png|left]] |version2 = [[File:Black Guard (Making Friends with My Arm, 2) chathead.png|left]] |version3 = [[File:Black Guard (Making Friends with My Arm, 3) chathead.png|left]] }} '''Black Guard''' are dwarves seen during a cutscene in [[Making Friends with My Arm]]. The cutscene shows a flashback where the Black Guard dwarves guard the entrance to [[Keldagrim]], but are overpowered by attacking [[Troll (Making Friends with My Arm)|trolls]]. The trolls are then defeated by the [[Wise Young Man]], after which the remaining Black Guard express their thanks.
{{Making Friends with My Arm}}

revision.text:
{{external|rs=Black Knight captain}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Black Knight Captain |image = [[File:Black Knight Captain.png|180px]] |release = [[6 April]] [[2001]] |update = Massive update! |members = No |race = [[Human]] |quest = [[Black Knights' Fortress]] |location = [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]] |gender = Male |options = Talk-to |examine = One of the Black Knights. |map = {{Map|x=3028|y=3508|plane=0|r=4|mapID=-1|mtype=square}} |id = 4777 |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} [[File:Black Knight Captain chathead.png|left]] The '''Black Knight Captain''' is a prominent member of the [[Kinshra]] order in north-eastern [[Asgarnia]]. The captain can be seen in an inaccessible part of the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]] on [[Ice Mountain]], alongside [[Greldo]], a [[Witch (Lensig)|witch]] and her [[black cat]]. When players listen through the grills, the above persons can be heard plotting to a make a potion to assist in the destruction of the White Knights. Even in the conversation he has with the witch, the captain does not speak much. Because the room in which the captain is found cannot be entered, players are unable to interact with him, despite him having a talk option. If somehow one were to find a way to talk to him, he will tell the player to go away and find something to guard if the player is disguised as a fortress guard, or scold the player for being out of uniform if not.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/596211169762750464|date=7 May 2015|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200430203422/https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/596211169762750464|archivedate=30 April 2020|quote=[Heya Mod Ash, the captain of the black knight from black fortress quest has a talk to option. I always wonder what he say to u.] If you are dressed as a guard, he tells you to go away and guard something. Otherwise he tells you you're out of uniform.}} ==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|speaksin}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 7 August 2006 |update = Gnome Cuisine |change = *The NPC was graphically updated with the rework of Black Knights' Fortress. *The NPC was renamed from "Black Knight" to "Black Knight Captain". }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black Knight Captain (beta v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black Knight Captain (beta v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black Knight Captain (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black Knight Captain.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black Knight Captain chathead (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black Knight Captain chathead (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black Knight Captain chathead (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Black Knight Captain chathead.png|center]] |- |RS2 beta until

{{External|rs=Black Knights' Catacombs}} {{Infobox Location |name = Black Knight Catacombs |image = [[File:Black Knight Catacombs.png|300px]] |release = [[10 July]] [[2024]] |update = While Guthix Sleeps |members = Yes |location = Below the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]] |map = {{Map|name=Black Knight Catacombs|x=4128|y=4735|mapID=-1|height=550|plane=1|zoom=2}} |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} The '''Black Knight Catacombs''' is a large dungeon found below the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]] accessed during [[While Guthix Sleeps]] to find and defeat the [[Dark Squall]]. To access the Catacombs, the player must push the wall opposite the Fortress entryway and climb down the ladder ahead. Then, any [[Charge Orb]] spell must be used on the carved tile at the other end of the room, which permanently opens the trapdoor to the Catacombs. This can only be done after the quest has been started.
The Catacombs are a [[Multicombat area]] and contain many [[aggressive]], powerful [[Kinshra]]: [[Elite Black Knight]]s, [[Elite Dark Warrior]]s, [[Elite Dark Mage]]s, and [[Elite Dark Ranger]]s that can use [[protection prayers]] based on the player's attack style. Wearing a full set of [[elite black armour]] or [[Dark Squall robes]] will prevent their aggression.
A [[Dwarf multicannon]] '''cannot''' be placed inside the catacombs.
==Gallery== <gallery captionalign="center" widths="200"> Black Knight Catacombs - jail.png|The jail cells within the catacombs. Black Knight Catacombs - inner base.png|The Dark Squall's inner base. </gallery>
{{While Guthix Sleeps}} [[Category:Bases and headquarters]]

{{External|rs}} {{Otheruses|def=no|the fortress near Ice Mountain|Black Knights' Fortress (location)}} {{Infobox Location |name = Black Knights' Base |image = [[File:Black Knights' Base.png|300px]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |aka = Kinshra Base |members = Yes |location = [[Asgarnia]] |teleport = No |music = [[Royale]] |map = {{Map|name=Black Knights' Base|x=2906|y=9691|zoom=2|mapID=20}} |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} The '''Black Knights' Base''' is a [[Kinshra]] base in the far south of [[Taverley Dungeon]]. The base has two main areas, and both are swarming with [[black knight]]s. In the top right of the first area is a kitchen, with a sink and a range. In the far right area of the second compartment is the jail. To gain access to the jail cells, the [[jailer]] must be killed; his combat level is 47. Inside the south cell is [[Velrak the explorer]], who can give the player a [[dusty key]] which gives access shortcuts in the dungeon. It's also interesting to note that in the rooms on the side of the main hall there are helmet racks, which appear to have helmets on them that look suspiciously like [[White Knight]] helmets. Although the base is said to be in [[Taverley]] by [[Solus Dellagar]], it is actually underneath the [[Crafting Guild]].
To access the base, the player must enter the trapdoor south of Taverley and run past numerous monsters including [[chaos dwarf|chaos dwarves]] and [[hill giant]]s. Because of this, it is advised that lower levelled players take [[food]]. The base plays a part in the [[Wanted!]] quest, where the player must interrogate [[Lord Daquarius]] about the whereabouts of [[Solus Dellagar]].
==Inhabitants== As well as the [[Black Knight]]s around the base, there are some other characters at the base: *[[Velrak the explorer]] - A jailed explorer, Velrak can be found in the southern jail cell. *[[Lord Daquarius]] - The leader of the [[Kinshra]] can be found in the western room in the second area *[[Jailer]] - The level 47 jailer can be found by the jail in the far right of the second area. Players must kill him for a [[jail key]]. *[[Dwarf|Dwarves]] - Presumably captured by the black knights, the dwarves can be found in the northern jail cell.
{{Wanted!}} {{Taverley Dungeon}}

{{External|rs=Black Knights' Fortress (quest)|rsc=Black knight's fortress|dw=Black Knight's Fortress}} {{Has quick guide|speedrun=1}} {{otheruses|the quest|the building|Black Knights' Fortress (location)}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Black Knights' Fortress |number = 12 |image = [[File:Black Knights' Fortress.png|300px]] |release = [[6 April]] [[2001]] |update = Massive update! |members = No |series = None |developer = [[Paul Gower]] }} '''The Black Knights''' are up to no good. You are hired by the white knights to spy on them and destroy their secret weapon. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Speak to [[Sir Amik Varze]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the [[White Knights' Castle]]'s western tower in [[Falador]]. |startmap = 2959,3336,plane:2 |difficulty = Intermediate |description = The Black Knights are up to no good. You are hired by the white knights to spy on them and destroy their secret weapon. |length = Very Short |requirements = * {{SCP|Quest|12}} [[Quest points]] {{Questreqstart|yes}} * The ability to evade level 33 [[Black Knight]]s |items = * [[Cabbage]] (can be obtained from the cabbage patch in [[Edgeville Monastery]] and [[South Falador Farm]], as well as [[Lumbridge Castle#Cellar|Lumbridge cellar]]. Cabbages obtained from [[Draynor Manor]] '''CANNOT''' be used) * [[Iron chainbody]] (can be purchased at [[Horvik's Armour Shop]] in [[Varrock]] and from [[Wayne's Chains - Chainmail Specialist|Wayne's Chains]] in [[Falador]]) * [[Bronze med helm]] (can be purchased in the helmet shop in [[Barbarian Village]], spawns by the backdoor of [[Draynor Manor]]) |recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|15|link=yes}} * [[Food]] * [[Armour]] * [[Falador teleport]]s * ''([[Members]] only)'' [[Combat bracelet]] to the [[Edgeville Monastery|Monastery]] and head west towards the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]] |kills = None |leagueRegion = {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} — location requirement Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== ===Spy mission=== [[File:Sir Amik Varze chathead.png|left]] Talk to [[Sir Amik Varze]], who can be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} west wing of [[White Knights' Castle]] in [[Falador]]. Ask him for a quest, and he will tell you that he needs a spy to infiltrate the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]]. The Black Knights claim to have developed a powerful new secret weapon, and he wants you to find it and sabotage it. He will hand you a dossier (requires a free inventory space). Read it and it will self destruct, signifying the start of the quest. If you still need the required items, on the way to the fortress you can purchase an [[iron chainbody]] from [[Wayne's Chains - Chainmail Specialist|Wayne's Chains]] to the west of the southern entrance to Falador, a [[bronze med helm]] from [[Peksa]] in [[Barbarian Village]], and a [[cabbage]] may be taken from the [[Edgeville Monastery]]. ===Infiltrating the fortress=== {{Needed|An [[iron chainbody]], a [[bronze med helm]], and a [[cabbage]] not from Draynor Manor.}} {{Map|width=250|height=250|x=3020|y=3514|align=right|caption=The fortress is due north-east of Falador and slightly west of the Monastery.}} Make your way to the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]], located north-east of the [[Dwarven Mine]] and the [[Oracle]], and north-west of the [[Edgeville Monastery|Monastery]]. Run through the [[Black Knight]]s outside the fortress; they will be [[Aggressiveness|aggressive]] to players under 67 combat. Equip the [[Iron chainbody]] and [[Bronze med helm]] to disguise yourself as a Black Knight before entering through the southern door (you may enter with anything equipped in any of the other slots). :'''Note:''' You only need to be wearing the chainbody and med helm to enter the fortress - you can then unequip it and use the slots for something else. Throughout the following steps, there will be numerous black knights that will attack you. While in an area without any, make sure you have healed up and read ahead to the next steps to quickly pass them. {{Checklist| *Once inside, the wall right in front of you can be pushed. Push it to enter a small room. *Climb up the ladder in this small room. *Climb up the ladder immediately to the right of it. *Climb down the ladder just south. *Go through a door to the east. *Go up the closest ladder. *Climb down the ladder immediately to the east. *Open the sturdy door to the south and climb down the ladder to the west of it. }} In this small room, there will be a grill. Click on it to listen. You will overhear a conversation between the [[Black Knight Captain]], a [[Witch (Lensig)|witch]] and a [[goblin (race)|goblin]]. The witch is talking about an invincibility potion she has been working on - she needs [[Greldo]] the goblin to retrieve the final ingredient to complete it, a special type of cabbage grown only in [[Draynor Manor]]. She mentions that any other type of cabbage would wreck the potion. ===Sabotaging the secret weapon=== [[File:Fortress Guard chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]] [[File:Black Knights' Fortress - Cauldron.png|thumb|220px|Dropping the cabbage creates a strange reaction.]] :'''Note:''' Lower levelled players may choose to heal at the [[Edgeville Monastery]] to the east by speaking to a [[Monk]] before continuing. Return to the entrance of the building and enter the room directly east; after entering, the guard will warn you the Black Knights inside are in the middle of an important meeting, and will try to kill anyone that interrupts it. Click the option saying you don't care to enter the room, and then climb the ladder on the northern wall. Walk around the upper, L shaped landing, and Push the wall open. '''Right-click''' your [[cabbage]] so that you do not eat it, and use it on the hole. A cutscene will play showing the potion being destroyed by the cabbage. Return to [[Sir Amik Varze]], and tell him you sabotaged the weapon. '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' {{Clear}} ==Reward== {{Quest rewards |name = Black Knights' Fortress |image = [[File:Black Knights' Fortress reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 3 |rewards = * 2,500 [[Coins]] }} ==Required for completing== Completion of Black Knights' Fortress is required for the following: *[[King's Ransom]] *[[Recruitment Drive]] ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|Quest}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |daterange = 7 August 2006 |update = Gnome Cuisine |change = The quest underwent a major rework, with graphical updates and changes to dialogue. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 26 January -
25 June 2005 |update = |change = The quest was renamed from "Black Knight's Fortress" to "Black Knights' Fortress". }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 29 March 2004 |update = RS2 Launched! |change = The quest was renamed from "Black knight's fortress" to "Black Knight's Fortress". }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 28 May -
16 June 2001 |update = |change = The quest was renamed from "Spy quest" to "Black knight's fortress". }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *The quest point requirement was added to discourage players from creating new accounts to do the quest and transfer the 2,500 [[coins]] to their main characters. *If the player tries to throw a [[Draynor Manor]] cabbage down into the cauldron they will receive the chatbox message "This is the wrong sort of cabbage!", along with the character stating "I'm not supposed to be HELPING the witch you know..." *When talking to [[Sir Amik Varze]] to start the quest, he says "Your mission, should you decide to accept it". This is a reference to ''{{Wp|Mission: Impossible (film series)|Mission Impossible}}''. *The dossier given to you by Sir Amik Varze reads: "Infiltrate fortress... sabotage secret weapon... self destruct in 3...2...ARG!", which is another reference to ''Mission Impossible''. *This quest was named '''Spy quest''' until the Quest List was released on [[28 May]] [[2001]]. *At first, the quest gave around 250 [[Thieving]] experience as a reward. Thieving was in the skill menu at the time, but had not been programmed yet. The skill was later removed and added back in 2002, but the quest no longer gave Thieving experience. *When talking to Sir Amik Varze to start the quest, you can choose to say "I laugh in the face of danger!" This is most likely a reference to Simba in ''{{Wp|The Lion King}}''. {{Black Knights' Fortress}}

{{External|rs|rsc=Black Candle}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Unlit |version2 = Lit |name1 = Black candle |name2 = Lit black candle |image1 = [[File:Black candle.png]] |image2 = [[File:Lit black candle.png]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = Yes |quest = [[Merlin's Crystal]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options1 = Drop |options2 = Extinguish, Drop |examine1 = A spooky candle. |examine2 = A lit spooky candle. |value = 3 |weight = 0.028 |id1 = 38 |id2 = 32 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Black candle detail.png|left|130x200px]] |version2 = [[File:Lit black candle detail.png|left|130x200px]] }} A '''black candle''' is a [[light source]] used in the [[Merlin's Crystal]] [[quest]]. During Merlin's Crystal, in exchange for sparing [[Sir Mordred]]'s life, [[Morgan Le Faye]] details how to free Merlin, requiring a black candle among other things. The [[Candle maker]] in [[Catherby]] offers to make one if the player brings him a [[bucket of wax]]. Once all the other items are obtained, it is lit with a [[tinderbox]] when inside the magical symbol, inside the fence on the north-east side of [[Camelot Castle]]. After the remaining items are used, and with the correct incantation, [[Thrantax the Mighty]] is summoned for the player to command to free Merlin. Black candles can not be purchased from the Candle maker after Merlin's Crystal, but multiple can be obtained during the quest. Although they aren't tradeable, they can be put in [[empty candle lantern]]s to make [[candle lantern]]s, which are tradeable. ==Firemaking info== {{Firemaking info |version = Unlit |name = Black candle |level = 1 |type = light }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Merlin's Crystal]] |members = Yes |ticks = 1 |facilities = Candle maker |mat1 = Bucket of wax |output1 = Black candle |output1cost = No }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Black candle|Lit black candle}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 14 March 2005 |update = Lumbridge Swamp Caves |change = The "Extinguish" option was added. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Lit black candle detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Lit black candle detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Lit black candle (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Lit black candle.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2

{{External|rs=Black mushroom ink}} {{Otheruses|def=no|the item used to recolour graceful|Dark dye}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black dye |image = [[File:Black dye.png]] |release = [[11 April]] [[2005]] |update = The Golem |members = Yes |quest = [[The Golem]],

[[Land of the Goblins]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Empty, Drop |examine = Black dye made out of mushrooms. |value = 1 |weight = 0.010 |id = 4622 }} [[File:Black dye detail.png|left|130px]] '''Black dye''' is made by using a [[pestle and mortar]] on [[black mushroom]]s while having an empty [[vial]] in the inventory. It is used in [[The Golem]] quest to write a [[Golem program|program]] containing new instructions for the Golem to run. It is also used in [[Land of the Goblins]] to dye [[goblin mail]] black. '''Warning:''' Dyeing [[Silverlight]] black will consume '''all''' copies of the sword in your inventory, leaving you with only one dyed sword. It functions as a black dye and can be used on several items: *[[Desert shirt]], to create a [[black desert shirt]]. *[[Desert robe]], to create a [[black desert robe]]. *[[Blue wizard hat]], to create a black [[wizard hat]]. *[[Blue wizard robe]], to create a [[black robe]]. *Any basic coloured [[cape]], to create a [[black cape]]. *Any coloured [[goblin mail]], to create a [[black goblin mail]]. *[[Orange slices]], to create [[dyed orange]], after partial completion of [[Freeing the Goblin generals]]. *[[Origami balloon]]s. *[[Phoenix feather]], to create a [[phoenix quill pen]] which does '''not''' consume the ink. ==Creation== {{Recipe |members = Yes |ticks = 0 |tools = Pestle and mortar |mat1 = Vial |mat2 = Black mushroom |mat2cost = No |output1 = Black dye |output1cost = No }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Black dye}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 9 February 2022 |update = Land of the Goblins |change = * The item's name was changed from "Black mushroom ink" to "Black dye". * The examine text was changed; previously, it was "Black ink made out of mushrooms." }} {{Subject changes footer}} {{The Golem}} {{Shadow of the Storm}} {{Land of the Goblins}} {{Dye}} [[Category:Dye]]

{{Infobox Monster |name = Black jaguar |image = [[File:Black jaguar (Scrambled!).png|280px]] |release = [[23 July]] [[2025]] |update = Varlamore: The Final Dawn Out Now |members = Yes |combat = 88 |size = 2 |examine = The most intimidating cat in all of Varlamore. |xpbonus = |max hit = 8 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Slash]] |attack speed = 4 |hitpoints = 85 |att = 75 |str = 75 |def = 75 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 30 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |id = 14512 }} The '''black jaguar''' is the protector of the [[jaguar egg]] encountered during the [[Scrambled!]] quest. It can be found a campsite just north-east of the [[Crypt of Tonali]] lift platform. During the quest, the jaguar spawns and begins attacking the player when they search the pile of eggs at the camp. A chat message states, {{Mes|A nearby jaguar doesn't take kindly to you trying to take one of the eggs}}. The jaguar is stronger than the level 67 [[black jaguar]]s found south of [[Ralos' Rise]].
{{Scrambled!}}

They are used to create a [[black coffin]] by taking the locks and coffin to [[Dampe]]; this process is reversible via the "Remove-lock" option on the coffin.
Players cannot attach the locks on their own; attempting to do so results in a message in the chatbox stating "''You don't have the knowledge to attach the lock to the coffin, Dampe should be able to help.''"

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black mushroom |image = [[File:Black mushroom.png]] |release = [[11 April]] [[2005]] |update = The Golem |members = Yes |quest = [[The Golem]],
[[Shadow of the Storm]],
[[Land of the Goblins]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = It looks horrible. |value = 1 |weight = 0.010 |id = 4620 }} [[File:Black mushroom detail.png|left|100px]] The '''black mushroom''' is a [[quest item]] in [[The Golem]], [[Shadow of the Storm]] and [[Land of the Goblins]] [[quest]]s, found beneath the [[Ruins of Uzer]] and in the [[Goblin Cave]] by the entrance to the [[Goblin Temple]]. When used with a [[pestle and mortar]] and a [[vial]] in the inventory, [[black dye]] is made, which is used to dye several items black. ==Products== {{Uses material list|Black mushroom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 9 February 2022 |update = Land of the Goblins |change = The "Eat" option was removed from the item. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== * The name, shape, and properties of this fungi are a reference to real-world ink cap mushrooms, {{WP|Coprinopsis atramentaria}}, which were historically used for ink or dye. They also tend to be inedible, though not particularly harmful. * Prior to the release of [[Land of the Goblins]], the black mushroom had an "Eat" option. When eaten, it had no effects and healed no [[Hitpoints]], but the player received a chatbox message stating ''"Eugh! It tastes horrible, and stains your fingers black."'' {{The Golem}} {{Shadow of the Storm}} {{Land of the Goblins}}

{{External|rs=Black mushrooms (scenery)}} {{Infobox Scenery |name = Black mushrooms |image = [[File:Black mushrooms.png|250x250px]] |release = [[11 April]] [[2005]] |update = The Golem |members = Yes |quest = Yes |location = [[Ruins of Uzer]], [[Goblin Cave]] |options = Pick |examine = Not good for eating. |map = No |id = 6311 }} '''Black mushrooms''' are fungi that typically grow in old caves and ruins. ==Locations== {{ObjectTableHead}} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Black mushrooms |location = [[Goblin Cave]] |members = Yes |x:2577,y:9845|x:2583,y:9851|x:2604,y:9840|x:2601,y:9808|x:2612,y:9795|x:2580,y:9813 |mtype = pin |mapID = 2 |leagueRegion = kandarin }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Black mushrooms |location = [[Ruins of Uzer]] |members = Yes |x:3495,y:3088 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = desert }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Black mushrooms |location = [[Ruins of Uzer]] underground temple |members = Yes |x:2709,y:4888|x:2728,y:4888|x:2733,y:4910 |mtype = pin |mapID = 10169 |leagueRegion = desert }} {{ObjectTableBottom}}

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black nails |image = [[File:Black nails.png]] |release = [[17 May]] [[2005]] |update = Zogre Flesh Eaters |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = Yes |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = Keeps things in place fairly permanently. |value = 12 |weight = 0.000 |exchange = Yes |id = 4821 }} [[File:Black nails detail.png|left|150px]] '''Black nails''' are [[nail]]s which, unlike other nails, '''cannot''' be made by players. Black nails can be obtained from thieving [[Ogre coffins]] or as a drop from [[Zombie (Tarn's Lair)|zombies]] in [[Tarn's Lair]]. They may also be obtained while clearing rubble during the [[In Aid of the Myreque]] quest.
Black nails can be used to [[construct]] certain types of wooden [[furniture]]. With 38 [[Fletching]], they can be used on [[flighted ogre arrow]]s to create [[black brutal]] arrows, granting 6.5 Fletching experience per arrow.
==Products== {{Uses material list|Black nails}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black nails}} Black nails are also occasionally dropped from Rubble during the In Aid of the Myreque quest.

{{Gone|update=Optional Randoms & Goblins}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black pick head |image = [[File:Black pick head.png]] |release = [[12 June]] [[2014]] |update = Treasure Trail Expansion |removal = [[11 September]] [[2014]] |removalupdate = Optional Randoms & Goblins |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = It's missing a handle. |value = 1 |weight = 1.814 |id = 12592 }} [[File:Black pick head detail.png|left|150px]] A '''black pick head''' was obtained as part of a discontinued [[random event]], in which the [[black pickaxe]] head flew off the [[pickaxe handle|handle]] while the player was mining. To fix it, the player had to collect it off the ground and reattach it to the handle. If players were not paying attention when this occurred, the head would disappear from the ground or be picked up by another player, requiring them to purchase another. The pick heads were all repaired in an update on [[11 September]] [[2014]], and the event was discontinued. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |daterange = 9 – 16 October 2014 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |date = 11 September 2014 |update = Optional Randoms & Goblins |change = The item's value was decreased from 499 to 1. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black pick head detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Broken pickaxe (current) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black pick head.png|center]] |[[File:Broken pickaxe (current).png|center]] |- |12 June 2014 –

{{Otheruses|the regular black slayer helmet|the imbued version|Black slayer helmet (i)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black slayer helmet |image = [[File:Black slayer helmet.png]] |release = [[26 May]] [[2016]] |update = Maniacal Monkey Hunting |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Wear, Check, Disassemble, Drop |wornoptions = Check, Partner, Log |examine = You don't want to wear it inside-out. |value = 40000 |weight = 2.267 |id = 19639 }} [[File:Black slayer helmet detail.png|left|120px]] [[File:Black slayer helmet chathead.png|left]] The '''black Slayer helmet''' is a piece of equipment that is worn in the helmet slot. It is a cosmetic upgrade to the [[Slayer helmet]]. {{Cache}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Black swan |image = [[File:Black swan.png|250px]] |release = [[20 February]] [[2006]] |update = Updates, updates and more updates... |members = No |race = [[Bird]] |location = None |options = None |examine = A rare bird. |map = No |id = 1832 |leagueRegion = No }} The '''Black swan''' is an unused black variant of [[swan]]s. It was added with the graphical update of [[Falador]] in 2006, and presumably would have been found alongside regular swans in [[Falador Park]] and the moat around the [[White Knights' Castle]]. For unknown reasons, the black swan was never added to the game, and cannot currently be found anywhere.
==Trivia== *In real life, the {{wp|Black swan}} is a bird native to Australia. They were introduced to the United Kingdom where they are exceptionally rare; while approximately 32,000 swans exist, only 40 are black swans.

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Blackened crystal |image = [[File:Blackened crystal.png]] |release = [[17 October]] [[2005]] |update = Mourning's Ends Pt II |members = Yes |quest = [[Mourning's End Part II]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = A blackened crystal sample. |value = 1 |weight = 0.015 |id = 6650 }} [[File:Blackened crystal detail.png|left|150px]] The '''blackened crystal''' is a [[quest item]] used in the [[Mourning's End Part II]] [[quests|quest]]. It is obtained by using a [[chisel]] on a large black rock in the [[Temple of Light]] at the start of the quest. The player must give the crystal to [[Arianwyn]], who will then turn it into a [[newly made crystal]], which is needed to complete the final part of the quest. If a player has lost their blackened crystal, they must carve a new piece from the giant black crystal in order to get it back.
{{Mourning's End Part II}}

{{External|rs=The Black Hole|rsc=Black Hole}} {{Infobox Location |name = Blackhole |image = [[File:Thordur's black hole.png|300px]] |release = [[12 July]] [[2001]] |update = Improved prayer system and more! |members = No |location = [[Dwarven Mine]] |music = None |map = no |type = realm |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} The '''Blackhole''', also known as [[Thordur]]'s blackhole, was Jagex's early punishment system in ''[[RuneScape Classic]]'', before the [[ban]] system was implemented. Players who misbehaved were sent to the blackhole and would remain there for an undefined amount of time before being removed. It existed throughout most of 2001 until it was removed in December of that same year.
[[File:Blacker blackhole.png|thumb|265px|The blacker blackhole, accessible by using the "Blackout" option on the disk of returning.]] In ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', players are able to visit the blackhole by selecting the "Activate" option on the [[Disk of returning]] while in the [[Dwarven Mine]]s beneath [[Falador]]. Here they can interact with Thordur but will be unable to move around. The area and Thordur are not [[instance]]d contrary to popular belief, but as there is only 1 available tile in this area, anyone else appearing will be under you. Activating the disk again will return the player to the mines.
Players can also visit the blacker blackhole, which is an instanced area, by selecting the "Blackout" option on the disk of returning, which takes them to a blank space where they are free to move around. This space allows screenshots to be easily taken without background disruption. Players can leave using the light found in the south-west corner. '''Warning:''' Any items dropped on the ground in either hole will be deleted upon leaving.
The blackholes have strict teleportation restrictions that cause any teleportation method other than the disk of returning to be blocked, prompting the message ''"You can't teleport out of the hole!"'' Logging out and back in will return the player outside, though.
'''Note:''' You can still get out of both holes after dropping the disk of returning, either by talking to Thordur and asking how to get out, or by exiting through the light in the blacker blackhole.
==History== Upon the release of [[Thordur]]'s blackhole in early 2001, some players deliberately misbehaved and violated the [[Code of Conduct]] for the sole purpose of seeing what the blackhole was like. As a result of this, [[rsw:Andrew Gower|Andrew Gower]] made the decision to program a clone of the blackhole, so that any player could visit the area without breaking any rules. Those wishing to enter would visit Thordur in the western side of the [[Dwarven Mine]] under [[Falador]], who would sell them a [[disk of returning]] for 10 [[coins]]. Once the player obtained the disk, they were then able to climb down a nearby ladder to access the cloned blackhole and would use the disk of returning to get out.
The blackhole and its clone were removed from the game in December 2001 due to a [[scam]] where unsuspecting players were told "something interesting would happen" if they dropped their disk of returning, causing them to be stuck in the blackhole until a Jagex staff member removed them.
==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 26 November 2015 |update = Zulrah Scale Fishing |poll = Old School Content Poll 37: Skillcape Perks |change = The blank space is an area with nothing in it but a dark map square. To access this space, find your way to the Dwarven mine located underneath Falador, right click a disk of returning and select the 'Blackout' option. You will then be transported to the blank space and can leave using the light found in the south-west corner. }} {{Subject changes footer}}
==Trivia== *Before the update that added Thordur's blackhole to ''RuneScape Classic'', the official game manual did not acknowledge this method of punishment. As such, some players who had been placed in the hole often reported it as a bug. *Near the end of the [[20th Anniversary event]], players inside the [[Realm of Memories]] before it was removed could find themselves briefly in the blacker blackhole after the [[Update:Shades of Mort'ton Rework|update]].
{{Realms}} {{Dwarven Mine}}

{{Infobox Item |version1 = Normal |version2 = Glowing |name = Blackstone fragment |image1 = [[File:Blackstone fragment.png]] |image2 = [[File:Blackstone fragment (glowing).png]] |release = [[26 July]] [[2023]] |update = Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire |members = Yes |quest = [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Activate, Recall, Destroy |destroy = '''During quest''': Ketla in the Lassar Undercity might be able to give you another.
'''After quest''': You might be able to get another from Ketla's workbench in the Lassar Undercity. |examine1 = A strange shard of dark stone with various modifications. |examine2 = It's vibrating with energy! |value = 100 |alchable = No |weight = 0.500 |id1 = 28357 |id2 = 28356 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Blackstone fragment detail.png|left|130px]] |version2 = [[File:Blackstone fragment (glowing) detail.png|left|130px]] }} The '''blackstone fragment''' is a modified shard of the [[Ancient Pillar (Desert Treasure II)|ancient pillar]] found in the [[Lassar Undercity]]. It is obtained from [[Ketla]] after showing her the [[ring of visibility]] during [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]]. During the quest, it is used to instantly leave the [[Shadow Realm]] within the Lassar Undercity upon activating it. It can be also used to recall the [[shadow blocker]], [[revitalising idol]], and [[anima portal]] back to the player's inventory from wherever they were placed. The fragment must also be in the player's inventory during the fight against [[The Whisperer]], as it is used at various points in the fight where her attacks must be countered from within the Shadow Realm; the player will be prompted to activate it when it begins glowing yellow. Without the fragment, the player will refuse to fight her. If players lose the fragment, it can be re-obtained by speaking to [[Ketla]], or from Ketla's workbench in the Residential District, located in the building just north of the Western Residential District [[teleporter]]. ==Trivia== * Inspecting the [[ancient mould]] in the [[Grimstone Dungeon]] with a blackstone fragment in the inventory results in additional dialogue. {{Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire}}

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Infobox Item |name = Blamish oil |image = [[File:Blamish oil.png]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = Yes |quest = [[Heroes' Quest]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drink, Drop |examine = Made from the finest snail slime. |value = 10 |weight = 0.025 |id = 1582 }} [[File:Blamish oil detail.png|left|130px]] '''Blamish oil''' is a [[quest]] [[quest item|item]] used in [[Heroes' Quest]]. It is made through the [[Herblore]] [[skill]], and it turns a normal [[fishing rod]] into an [[oily fishing rod]]. Oily fishing rods can only be used at lava fishing spots to catch [[raw lava eel|lava eels]] or [[infernal eel]]s. To make blamish oil, combine [[blamish snail slime]] with a [[harralander potion (unf)]]. It requires level 25 [[Herblore]] to be made and gives 80 [[Herblore]] [[experience]]. Completion of [[Heroes' Quest]] is not required to create the blamish oil in this way. After completion of [[Heroes' Quest]], blamish oil is a rare drop from the citizens of [[Rellekka]] and the citizens of [[Canifis]], only if they are in human form, which requires a [[wolfbane]] dagger to stop them from transforming into [[werewolf|werewolves]]. Blamish oil has a "Drink" option, but if a player attempts to do so, their character says, "You know... I'd really rather not." ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Herblore |skill1lvl = 25 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 80 |members = Yes |ticks = 2 |mat1 = Blamish snail slime |mat1cost = No |mat2 = Harralander potion (unf) |output1 = Blamish oil |output1cost = No }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Blamish oil}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Blamish oil}} ==Changes== ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Blamish oil detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Blamish oil detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Blamish oil (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Blamish oil.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2

{{external|rs}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Blasidar the sculptor |image = [[File:Blasidar the sculptor.png|130px]] |release = [[31 May]] [[2005]] |update = Keldagrim - The Dwarven City |members = Yes |race = [[Dwarf (race)|Dwarf]] |quest = [[The Giant Dwarf]] |location = East [[Keldagrim]] |gender = Male |options = Talk-to |examine = Makes sculptures. |map = {{Map|name=Blasidar the sculptor|x=2907|y=10205|mapID=10|r=4|mtype=square}} |id = 2347 |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} [[File:Blasidar the sculptor chathead.png|left]] '''Blasidar the sculptor''' is a dwarven sculptor from [[Keldagrim]] who features heavily in [[The Giant Dwarf]] quest.
During The Giant Dwarf, the statue of [[King Alvis]] (the last king of [[Keldagrim]] and founder of the Mining [[Consortium]]) is destroyed. Blasidar is then selected to rebuild the statue with the help of the player. There are many unexpected difficulties to this, however.
Blasidar can be found on the east side of the dwarven capital of Keldagrim, in the building directly east of the palace and north of the Brewery. The building contains two [[NPCs]] (which appear as yellow dots on the [[minimap]]) - Blasidar and [[Riki the sculptor's model]].
If you engage in conversation with Blasidar, he will proceed to ask you to help him rebuild the statue. This includes gathering [[ore]], buying clothing, and even searching for a [[dwarven]] model.

The '''Blast Furnace''' is a members-only [[minigame]] situated in [[Keldagrim]] that involves [[smelting]] [[bar]]s in bulk. The [[furnace]] here only requires half as much coal compared to a standard one, which is useful when smelting high-tier [[ore]]s that require more coal.
==Requirements== * Started {{SCP|Quest}} [[The Giant Dwarf]] to gain access to [[Keldagrim]]. * {{NoCoins|2500|c}} per 10 minutes of use. {{SCP|Smithing|60|link=yes}}{{Boostable|no}} allows you to skip this fee. ** Equipping the [[ring of charos (a)]] will reduce the entrance fee to {{NoCoins|1250|c}}, if you go through [[Blast Furnace Foreman]]'s dialogue {{Chat option|1|3|2|3}}. * On Blast Furnace [[World#Themed worlds|themed worlds]], {{NoCoins|72000|c}} per hour (1,200 coins per minute) must be deposited into the [[coffer (Blast Furnace)|coffer]] near the bank chest to pay the dwarven workers operating the blast furnace. The fee is time-based ({{NoCoins|12|c}} per [[RuneScape clock|tick]]). Coins in the coffer are only spent while logged in at the Blast Furnace basement on a Blast Furnace world. The unspent amount can be withdrawn at any time, even in non-Blast Furnace worlds. * On non-Blast Furnace themed worlds the furnace must be operated manually, see below. * [[Ice gloves]], [[smiths gloves (i)]], or a [[bucket of water]] are needed to cool down metal bars quickly, to avoid waiting for them to cool down with time.
==Transportation== [[File:Getting to Keldagrim.png|thumb|right|From [[Seers' Village]] and [[Camelot]], follow this path.]] The Blast Furnace is located in [[Keldagrim]]. To enter Keldagrim, the player must have started [[The Giant Dwarf]] [[quest]] by speaking to the Dwarven Boatman within the mines east of Rellekka. The map on the right shows a path the player can take walking from [[Seers' Village]]/[[Camelot]] to the mines east of Rellekka. Once the player has visited Keldagrim at least once, they can return via [[Keldagrim minecart system|mine cart]] from the [[Dwarven Mines]] under the [[Ice Mountain]] or the [[Grand Exchange]], or use [[Minigame Teleport]] to teleport right outside the Blast Furnace building.
The [[Fairy ring]] system can be used in two ways: Either travel to ring {{Fairycode|dkr}} to go immediately west of the [[Grand Exchange]], use its underwall tunnel north of the ring (requires 21 [[Agility]]) and then the mine cart, or travel to ring {{Fairycode|dks}}, which puts the player a short walk to the south-west to the Keldagrim entrance.
=== Bank chest === Near the water pump and the coffer is a bank chest, which players can use to more efficiently use the furnace. Note that time spent with the bank chest interface open '''will''' deplete the coins in the coffer.
==Official worlds== There are 22 Blast Furnace [[World#Themed worlds|worlds]] (15 listed and 8 unlisted) on ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', all of which make soloing the Blast Furnace easy as there are five different dwarves—[[Dumpy]], [[Stumpy]], [[Pumpy]], [[Numpty]], and [[Thumpy]]—operating the mechanics of the Blast Furnace, so the player only has to focus on running the ores to the conveyor belt. There is an additional {{NoCoins|72000|c}} fee per hour (12gp/tick) to use the Blast Furnace on these worlds, which is deposited in the coffer near the bank chest.
As ore and coal in the blast furnace are not lost when hopping worlds, it is possible to deposit ore onto the conveyor belt on a non-Blast Furnace world and pedal manually to deposit it into the melting pot, and then hop to a blast furnace world to retrieve bars without utilising the blast furnace coffer. Although this strategy reduces cost, the cost of using the official blast furnace worlds is minimal compared to the cost of the ores involved, making this highly impractical for nearly all players. Furthermore, the foreman's fee of 2,500 GP doesn't stay when you hop worlds, so you must pay the bribe again (or half the bribe with [[Ring of charos (a)]]) for every time you hop back to the non-Blast Furnace world if you're under 60 Smithing.

==Experience rates== {{Main|Blast Furnace/Strategies}} Full [[Smithing]] [[experience]] is gained from smelting the [[bar]]s. There is also an [[anvil]] nearby to smith on, requiring level 60 Smithing to access.
At the Blast Furnace, the following Smithing experience rates can be gained producing bars. The tables assume that the player is wearing [[ice gloves]] or [[smiths gloves (i)]] and, when applicable, has a [[coal bag]] or [[goldsmith gauntlets]] in their inventory, leaving 27 inventory slots occupied by ore. Hybrid bar patterns utilise 26 inventory slots for ore, as they need both the coal bag and the goldsmith gauntlets.
For better rates, use the Barbarian [[vial smash]] perk unlocked through [[Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl]] when sipping energy restores and stamina potions.

==Collecting raw materials== Raw materials can be obtained in two ways: #Having [[ore]] in the [[bank]], using the [[bank chest]]. #Buying ore from [[Ordan]] who runs the [[Ore Seller]] shop (up to [[mithril ore|mithril]]). Ordan usually sells ore cheaper than GE price, putting them in high demand and causing players to [[World hopping|world-hop]] for them.
==Operating the Blast Furnace== [[File:Blast Furnace Map.png|frame|A map of the Blast Furnace room itself.]] ===Blast Furnace worlds=== The official Blast Furnace worlds provide a great level of convenience and are the de-facto way to use the Blast Furnace. It is unlikely to find a player run furnace and, at most, the stations are used to train other skills. The process for operating the Blast Furnace on an official world is as follows: #Place [[coal]] and/or [[ore]] on the conveyor belt. #Cool down smelted bars with a [[bucket of water]]. This step can be skipped if [[ice gloves]] or [[smiths gloves (i)]] are equipped when collecting the bars. #Collect the [[bar]]s from the bar dispenser. #Bank. #Repeat.
===Manual operation=== Manually operating the Blast Furnace requires 30 Agility, Crafting, Firemaking, and Strength. The process for operating the Blast Furnace manually is as follows: # Place coal and/or ore on the '''[[Conveyor belt (Blast Furnace)|conveyor belt]]'''. # Turn the conveyor belt by operating the '''[[pedals]]'''. # Repair any broken '''[[Cogs (Blast Furnace)|cogs]]''', '''[[Pipes (Blast Furnace)|pipes]]''', or '''[[drive belt]]''' using a [[hammer]]. # Collect '''[[coke]]''' from storage using a [[spade]] to obtain a [[spadeful of coke]]. # Refuel the adjacent '''[[Stove (Blast Furnace)|stove]]''' with the scooped-up coke. # Operate the '''[[Pump (Blast Furnace)|pump]]''', while keeping the pipes repaired. # Keep an eye on the '''[[temperature gauge]]''' to prevent the furnace from overheating. # Cool down smelted bars with a bucket of water from the [[sink (Blast Furnace)|sink]]. This step can be skipped if ice gloves or smiths gloves (i) are equipped. # Collect the bars from the '''[[bar dispenser]]'''. # Bank. # Repeat.
===World Hopping=== Using the no-payment world hopping strategy requires 30 Agility. The process for the World Hopping strategy is as follows: # Hop to a world that is not an official Blast Furnace world. # Load coal and/or ore on the conveyor belt. Load coal up to either the cap or the amount planned to be used if using coal, then load up to 28 ore. # If necessary, repair the drive belt using a hammer, requiring 30 Crafting. The '''[[Imcando hammer]]''' is preferred to save an inventory slot. Alternatively, begin the process on a world with a non-broken drive belt. '''Do not change worlds''' to hop to one with a functioning drive shaft while you have ores on the conveyor belt, as they will be lost. # Pedal for 4 ticks to deposit your ores into the '''[[Melting Pot]]'''. # Hop to an official Blast Furnace world. # Cool down smelted bars with a bucket of water from the sink. This step can be skipped if ice gloves or smiths gloves (i) are equipped. # Collect the bars from the bar dispenser. # Bank. # Repeat the process with your desired pattern, bulk-loading coal, if needed, every few cycles depending on consumption rate
===Notes=== *'''Caution:''' When smelting [[steel bar]]s, make sure that coal is already loaded in the furnace, or at least deposited ''before'' the [[iron ore]]. Otherwise, the furnace will yield iron instead of steel. *The [[coal bag]] can be filled straight from the bank by using the Fill option on it, which is accessible with a shift-click. *The maximum amount of coal and tin which may be placed in the Blast Furnace is 254 ores each, or a little over 9 inventories. *The maximum amount of primary ores (the metal itself) which may be placed in the Blast Furnace is 28, and another 28 bars may be stored at one time. Attempting to place more than 28 primary ores without collecting the 28 bars in the dispenser results in an error that says: "You should collect your bars before making any more." <!-- This is extremely long-winded and only marginally useful, it needs rewriting if not removing. *If the player seems to be getting 56 or 57 experience when smelting gold bars instead of 1517 or 1518, it indicates some bars may have been left in the dispenser. There appears to be an in-game bug that allows depositing up to 28 more gold ores after having placed 27. Doing this will grant 56.2 experience for smelting gold bars with the goldsmith gauntlets until 28 remain to be collected, and then 22.5 * the amount of extra gold bars worth of XP is granted upon collection. This will show that the player has only 28 gold bars to be collected, but there may be up to 55 gold bars remaining instead.--> *Logging out or disconnecting while only coal is upon the conveyor belt results in permanent loss of that coal. However, if the coal is paired with another ore, it will remain on the belt after disconnecting. *If using ice gloves and goldsmith gauntlets, remember not to equip the ice gloves UNTIL the smelting process is complete and the experience drops. Doing so too early negates the gauntlets' bonus. For safety, equip the gauntlets again as soon as the bars are collected. *On Blast Furnace activity worlds, the minimum amount of money required for a single run that should be deposited in the coffers is {{NoCoins|109|c}} if running, and {{NoCoins|217|c}} if walking. This requires standing north of the coffers and moving directly towards the conveyor belt on the same tick as depositing the coins. *Exiting via the stairs will stop the depletion of coins within the coffer, and can be used as a way to take breaks. *A token amount of [[Bar dispenser#Contribution experience|contribution experience]] is awarded to all participants when bars are dispensed during manual operation of the Blast Furnace. *Hopping while pedalling may break the pedals in the target world. If hopping to a unofficial blast furnace world get off the bike to avoid leaving the conveyor belt stuck.
==Products== {{Uses facility list|Blast Furnace}}
==Ordan the Ore Seller== {{main|Ordan|Ore seller.}} The [[Ore seller.]], run by [[Ordan]], is one of many of the [[stores in Keldagrim]] and can be found immediately west of the conveyor belt. The shop is restocked by [[dwarves]] that regularly enter the room and deliver a number (around 30) of one type of ore to the shop, rather than restocking 1 of every ore periodically. When the shop stocks 100 of a particular ore type the extra are "sent to storage".

==Trivia== *Contrary to popular belief, the temperature of the stove does not affect the chance of a pipe becoming broken. *The conveyor belt that moves the ores into the furnace has three separate sections turning independently. However, only the outer two are connected to the pedal mechanism; the inner one turns by itself. *In the Q&A on [[11 February]] [[2010]], Paul Gower stated that the Blast Furnace was created during an attempt to make a Smithing Guild. *Originally, the Blast Furnace did not have dwarves working on the machines. They were added due to player complaints of saboteurs breaking the machines constantly. *The bar dispenser doesn't work while a dialogue box is open. *None of the [[transformation rings]] can be worn while operating the pump or pedals, as this would result in rather odd animations. *There is a table at Blast Furnace which items can be placed upon for up to 10 minutes without becoming visible to other players. This may be useful to [[Ultimate Ironmen]].
